source: Transcription of rows 1-43 of the merchant's sample xlsx (sheet1.xml, sharedStrings.xml, styles.xml), spec E.10 / XL-1. Values are the cached <v> snapped to 15 significant digits (float noise removed); shared formulas are expanded; colours are resolved RGB (theme 1 = FF000000, theme 2 tint -0.5 = FF767171).
comparison: Formulas are compared after expanding the sample's shared formulas (L3:L5 si=0, L8:L24 si=1, ...).

Borders of merged ranges are compared by their outer edges only (mergeOuterBorders: an edge counts when the cell or the neighbour facing it carries a border, which is how Excel draws it); other cells by their own four sides.

Intentional differences (E.10): the E-footer is =ROWS(B{first}:B{last}) instead of the sample's constant (same value); explicit row heights (ht=16.8 customHeight=1); sheet name «اظهار» instead of Sheet1; a print-titles defined name; exact decimal cached values; shared formulas written as plain formulas and uniform thin borders inside merges; shrinkToFit=1 on data cells (rows 3 onwards, not footers).
